summary.business_type: Multi-company operating group / AI infrastructure (corporate umbrella)
top_findings: Homepage + article index are well-structured with valid Organization schema, 868 words, 96/100 content quality, and solid security headers
120 of 357 sitemap URLs lack a canonical tag; 115 lack Open Graph and Twitter Card meta
112 pages have no meta description; 46 pages have no H1
llms.txt returns 404 — Lighthouse agentic readiness drops the audit
robots.txt deliberately blocks 10+ AI crawlers (GPTBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), contradicting GEO/AI-search goals
logo.png uses alt="•" on all pages — decorative alt on the primary brand image
Duplicate titles: The-Alien-Minds-We-Built.html vs its /index.html; panteon login.html vs secure.alieninc.tech
quick_wins: Publish /llms.txt with H1 + summary + markdown links to all 7 company portals
Decide AI-crawler policy: if GEO/AI Overviews visibility matters, allow Google-Extended and PerplexityBot (keep GPTBot/CCBot blocked if preferred)
Add meta description + canonical + OG/Twitter tags to the 115 pages that lack them (extend tools/inject-seo.py pattern to non-subdomain pages)
Remove or fix the /trust/index.html 404 in the sitemap
Set logo.png alt to a meaningful value (e.g. 'Alien Inc logo') or alt="" if purely decorative
Fix duplicate article title by canonicalizing the /index.html variant

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: sitemap.xml found and serving 357 URLs (urlset format)
robots.txt reachable, well-commented, blocks admin/api/vault paths
356/357 URLs return 200; proper 404 page with noindex for unknown URLs
HTTPS + HSTS preload, CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff
Cloudflare + Fastly CDN caching in front

findings.title: 120 pages missing canonical
findings.description: Crawl of 357 sitemap URLs found 120 without <link rel=canonical>.
findings.recommendation: Self-referencing canonical on every page; extend tools/inject-seo.py beyond the 8 subdomains.

findings.title: Sitemap lists a 404 URL
findings.description: https://alieninc.tech/trust/index.html returns 404 but is in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Remove from sitemap.xml or restore the page.

findings.title: Duplicate titles
findings.description: articles/2026/09/24/The-Alien-Minds-We-Built.html and articles/2026/09/24/index.html share the same title/description; panteon login.html and secure.alieninc.tech also share 'Panteon — Secure Portal'.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage: 868 words, quality 96/100 (filler 0, AI-pattern 0, density 1.00)
Strong E-E-A-T signals: founder page, founding date, legal name, named founder in schema
Specific, verifiable claims (compliance frameworks, founding date 2016-12-22)

findings.title: 112 pages missing meta description
findings.description: 31% of indexed pages have no meta description, forcing Google to auto-generate snippets.
findings.recommendation: Write 120-155 char descriptions for all key pages; automate via inject-seo.py.

findings.title: 46 pages missing H1
findings.description: Mostly panteon.alieninc.tech subpages (yono-forge, pipeline-builder, cmb-* pages).
findings.recommendation: Add a unique H1 to each page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage has canonical, OG, Twitter Card, Organization JSON-LD
Title tag is clear and branded: 'Alien Inc. – Guardian of Philippine Digital Infrastructure'
Single H1 on homepage (good hierarchy)

findings.title: 115 pages missing Open Graph
findings.description: No og:title/og:image on 32% of pages — poor social/LinkedIn/Facebook preview control.
findings.recommendation: Add OG + Twitter Card tags site-wide.

findings.title: logo.png alt='•' on every page
findings.description: Brand logo uses a bullet as alt text — bad accessibility and a missed image-SEO signal.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage Organization JSON-LD is valid: @id, legalName, foundingDate, founder Person, sameAs (6 profiles)
Crawl found 38 WebPage, 4 Organization, 1 AboutPage blocks across sampled pages
1 block per homepage, valid, 3160 bytes

findings.title: 110 pages missing structured data
findings.description: Most article and product pages carry no JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add Article schema to /articles/, WebSite schema sitewide, BreadcrumbList on nested pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Served via Cloudflare + Fastly, gzip, cached edges in MNL
Static HTML (no SPA shell detected), no JS render required for primary content
Cache-Control: max-age=600 + Age header present

findings.title: No CrUX/PSI field data collected
findings.description: Google PageSpeed/CrUX APIs require an API key that isn't configured, so lab/field CWV were not measured.
findings.recommendation: Configure GOOGLE_API_KEY to enable pagespeed_check.py for real INP/LCP/CLS numbers.

findings.title: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts with preconnect
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts or add font-display: swap to protect LCP.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Primary content readable without JavaScript (agentic_check P0 pass)
robots.txt reachable; unknown URLs return real 404
WebMCP tools annotated on forms (P2 info)
Content-Signal preference declared

findings.title: llms.txt returns 404
findings.description: /llms.txt is not published. Lighthouse drops the agentic-readiness audit from its fraction; publishing one adds a counted pass.
findings.recommendation: Publish /llms.txt with an H1, a '>' summary, and markdown links to all 7 company portals and key pages.

findings.title: robots.txt blocks 10+ AI crawlers
findings.description: GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, Claude-Web, cohere-ai, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Diffbot are all Disallowed. Blocking an AI search crawler removes the site from that engine's answers.
findings.recommendation: Confirm intentional. If GEO/AI Overviews visibility is a goal, allow Google-Extended and PerplexityBot; keep training bots (GPTBot/CCBot/Bytespider) blocked if desired.

findings.title: ai-catalog.json / A2A agent card absent
findings.description: Agentic Resource Discovery and A2A agent card endpoints are not present (na).
findings.recommendation: Consider publishing /ai-catalog.json and /.well-known/agent-card.json to be discoverable by AI agents.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Only 1 image on homepage (logo) — minimal payload
OG/Twitter image strategy in place on main pages

findings.title: logo.png alt text is '•'
findings.description: Brand logo has a non-descriptive bullet alt on every page.
findings.recommendation: Set meaningful alt or empty alt if decorative.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Publish /llms.txt (H1 + summary + markdown links to 7 portals)
Resolve AI-crawler robots.txt policy (align with GEO goals)
Remove or restore the /trust/index.html 404 in sitemap

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add meta description + canonical to the 112/120 pages missing them
Add OG + Twitter Card to the 115 pages missing them
Add H1 to the 46 pages missing it

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add Article schema to /articles/ and WebSite/BreadcrumbList sitewide
Configure GOOGLE_API_KEY for CrUX/PSI field data
Self-host or font-display:swap the Google Fonts
Publish ai-catalog.json + A2A agent card for agent discoverability

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Run agentic_check.py monthly to track readiness score
Re-crawl sitemap after each deploy to catch regressions
Track Google updates via seo_updates.py to stay current
